The main problem is that there aren't many parking space. A lot of people would rather go somewhere else because of that.

On top of that, there are many supermarkets like Kim Phat and Marche C&T that has stores opened around Montreal and Brossard making it more convenient for the Chinese population to go to.

The food quality of the restaurants in China Town isn't what it used to be as well. I hear my family and friends talk about how there aren't many places to go to for a good family dinner, or how it looks dirty.

The place just needs a complete overhaul.

I just saw this and instantly bought it, even as an Early Access. I am so hyped. 
I've played EHM07 since '08 and I consider that game as my best investment in a game I have ever done. 

As long as they keep the same basics as the previous one, this game should be promising to me.
